description: Diagnostic module to audit temporal_stability signal discrimination. Reads mcp_signal_scores table via write_service /query WHERE dimension='temporal_stability'. Computes distinct score count and range. Reports back with verdict: OK if >20 distinct scores, WEAK if fewer. Signal quality diagnostic shows temporal_stability as WEAK with range 40-90 but low variety. This auditor identifies exactly which MCPs share identical scores and why. Does NOT write to database. Used by signal_discrimination_auditor.py pattern but focused specifically on temporal_stability enrichment gap.
